messages:
Lila: hey team, tiny emergency break — meet Piper 🐷 my grandma adopted her last month and she came over with the tiniest sweater. pic: https://files.slack.com/files-pri/T12345-F98765/piper_sweater.jpg (reactions: :heart: x5)
Evan: no way that is illegal levels of adorable 😭 where did gran get that??
Lila: county fair vendor — hand-knitted. tiny pompom on the tail. she squeals when you jingle your keys.
Hao: tiny pompom!!! also if Piper wrote release notes: "fixed nap scheduling, improved snoring." :joy:
Sam: can we put Piper on the next all-hands slide as Mascot-in-Training? :raised_hands:
Nora: vote: Piper for official office mascot :pig: (cast by emoji below)
Evan: +1 (reactions: :thumbsup: x2)
Lila: posting a short clip of her doing a roll: https://files.slack.com/files-pri/T12345-F23456/piper-roll.mp4 — it's 6s of pure chaos and sweater fluff
Hao: saw it. my heart melted. :heart_eyes: :sob:
Sam: Ada's bun wants a rematch — Ada says her rabbit AdaBun will challenge Piper to a cuddle-off at lunch.
Ada: challenge accepted. bring carrot bribes.
Noah: i'll bring my pupper (Rolo) for moral support. he'll be team dog, cheering from the sidelines. gif: https://giphy.com/gifs/dog-cheer-abc123
Nora: tiny informal poll: react to this thread with the emoji for who you want at "bring-your-pet" slack week opener — :pig: Piper, :rabbit: AdaBun, :dog: Rolo.
Evan: :pig:
Hao: :rabbit:
Sam: :dog:
Lila: :pig: :sparkles: (reactions: :sparkles: x3)
Nora: tallying results. thanks for the micro break, everyone :relieved:
Lila: also grandma says Piper will accept fan mail (no actual stamps necessary).
